issue.title: [A+] Align format vs format:check globs
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Part of **A+ Process / CI**. `docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md` notes `format` vs `format:check` glob drift.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Format scripts may not check the same file set they write.

**Expected:** `format` and `format:check` globs aligned (or intentional difference documented).

## Scope

**In scope**
- Align `package.json` scripts
- Update onboarding note if fixed

**Out of scope**
- Mass unrelated formatting of the whole repo beyond what the aligned check requires (prefer minimal diff; if huge, call out)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Globs aligned or documented
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes on `main` after change
- [ ] Engineering-only — no Needs QA

## Verification / test plan

1. `npm run format:check`
2. lint/typecheck if needed

## Links

- `package.json`, `docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md`
